# Packet — popol-vuh-021: The death of Hunahpu and Xbalanque; the two poor dancers (fols. 28v–30r)

The established text (pinned) follows, one paragraph per block. A unit's `t` is cut from it by script (a sentence, or a long sentence or litany cut at a syntactic joint; couplets never split).

¶1
Are cut vae qui nabal qui camic Hunahpu, Xbalanque; are va qui nabal qui camic xchi ca biyh chic.

¶2
Ta xe pixabah cut, xqui bano ronohel caxcol rail xban chique; maui xe camic rumal v tihobal Xibalba, maui xe chacatahic rumal ronohel honel chicop ꜭo chi Xibalba. Cate cut ta xqui tac chi caib nicvachinel, queheri e ilol; are qui bi va Xulu, Pacam, e etamanel: “Vve ꜭoh ꜩonoxic chive cumal rahaual Xibalba rumal ri ca camic, qui naoh ca qui nuc, rumal ri maui mi xoh camic, ma pu mi xoh chacatahic, mi xca zach qui tihobal, ma xa chicop choc chique. Are cu retal va chi ca ꜭux: chohim abah camizabal que cumal. Mi xe cucha quib ronohel Xibalba; macu quiꜩih ta coh camic. Are cu i naoh va xchi ca biyh: Vue quix ul ꜩonobex xoc cumal chirech ca camic ta coh catoc, naqui xchi cu chah, ix Xulu, ix Pacam? Vve que ꜭha chive: Ma vꜩ lo chi ca tix ta qui baquil pa zivan, vve ma ba vꜩ? Xavi xere chic chi ꜭaztah qui vach, quix ꜭha. Vve ba are vꜩ xa chi ca xequeba chuvi che ta? que ꜭha chic chive. Xax ma vꜩ vi; xavi xere chivil chi qui vach, quix ꜭha. Ta quecha chi cut chi roxmul: Xa ba re vꜩil xa chi ca tix qui baquil pa racan ha? Ve cut quix vchax chic cumal: Are vꜩ bala que camic; cate cu vꜩ chi hoc qui baquil chuvach abah, queheri chi queex cahim hal, huhunal cu chi queic; cate cu chi tix vbic chi racan a, chiri cah cua, chi be chuti huyub, nima huyub, quix ꜭha cut, ta chi cutunizah ri ca pixab mixca biyh chive,” xeꜭha Xhunahpu, Xbalanque, ta xe pixabic; xquetamah qui camic.

¶3
Are ca ban ri nima chohim abah, queheri chohibal qui xqui ban Xibalba; nimac xac xqui coho. Catecut xul zamahel achbilai que v zamahel Huncame, Vvcub Came: “Que petoc. Coh be ta cuꜭ ꜭaholab; chi be ta qui la: ca quix ca chohih, caꜭha ahau, ix ꜭaholab,” xe vꜭhaxic. “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha cut. Anim xebec, xe opon cut chu chi choh. Chiri cut xe rah chih vi chi eꜩanem: “Ca chopih vae ri ca quiy; cahtac mul tah chi ca xicah chi ca huhunal, ix ꜭaholab,” xeꜭhax cut rumal Huncame. “Maui are coh i mich vi ri. Ma pa quetaam ca camic, ix ahauab, chi vi tana?” xeꜭha cut. Ta xqui culavachih qui vach, xqui rip qui cab qui cabichal, e pu hupuhuh ta xebec pa choh; chiri cut xecam vi qui cabichal.

¶4
Que quicot chi cut ronohel Xibalba, tacal qui yuyub, tacal qui xulcab: “Mi xe ca chaco quiꜩih; maui atan xqui ya quib,” xeꜭha.

¶5
Catecut qui taquic ri Xulu, Pacam, xcanah vi qui ꜩih. Xavi xare xꜩonox ri xbe vi qui baquil; ta xe ꜫihin Xibalba, xhoc qui baquil, xbe tix oc chi racan a. Macu xebe ta chi nah; xa huzu xecah chuxe a, e chaom ꜭaholab xe vxic; xavi xere qui vach xuxic, xecutun chi cut.

¶6
Chi robix cut xecutun chic, xe il chi ya rumal vinac, e caib queheri xa vinac car xe vachinic ta xil qui vach cumal Xibalba; xe ꜩucux cut chi tac ya. Xchueca cut que cutun oc e caib chi meba, aꜩiyac qui vach, aꜩiiac pu quih, aꜩiiac cul qui cu; mana chi banan ta qui vach. Ta qui xe ilic rumal Xibalba, hala chi cut xqui bano: xa xahoh Puhuy, xahoh Cux, xa Yboy xqui xaho; xa Xꜩul, xa Chiꜩic xqui xah chic. Qui ia maihabal xqui ban chic: xqui poroh ha queheri quiꜩih chi catic, libah chi cut chi vinaquir chic. Ꜩaꜩ chi Xibalba chi cayic. Cate chi qui puz quib, chi cam hun chique, chi pune na chi caminaquil; nabe chi qui camizah quib, xavi xere libah chi caztah vi chi v vach. Xa qui cay Xibalba ta chi qui bano ronohel; xqui ban chic v xenacahic chic chacbal quech Xibalba cumal.

¶7
Cate chi puch roponic chic v ꜩihel qui xahoh chi xiquin ahauab Huncame, Vvcub Came. Xcha ta xqui tao: “Naqui ri e caib meba la? Quiꜩih vi chi cuz?” “Quiꜩih vi pu chi hebelic qui xahouic, ronohel ca qui bano,” xꜭha cut qui ꜩihoxic xoponic cuꜭ ahauab. Cuz xqui tao. Ta xbochi cut qui zamahel tacol chique: “Petoc, chul ta qui bana ca cay, que ca maihah tah, que ca cayih ta puch, quecha ahauab, quix ꜭha chique,” xuꜭhax ri zamahel.

¶8
Xe opon cut cuꜭ ri xahol, ta xꜭhao cut qui ꜩih ahauab chique. “Ma ba chi cah, rumal ri quiꜩih coh xobic. Ma xa maui coh quixbic, coh oc apanoc chi ahaual ha, rumal qui iꜩel ca vach? Ma xa qui nimac v bac ca vach chi meba? Ma xa on ril chire xa oh xahol? Naqui ta chi ca biyh chique, cach meba ꜭo cam cu raih nay pu ri ca xahoh, ca qui caztah qui vach cuꜭ? Ma quehe la cu xchi ca ban chique ri ahauab? Quehe cu maui ca cah vi, ix zamahel,” xeꜭha cut ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

¶9
Xelehebex na qui vach chuvi ra, chuvi cax, cacrail xebec. Maui atan xcah benam quiamul xechihic; xa chi mach cay zamahel chi qui vach, camol que ta xebec cut ruꜭ ahau.

## Establishment log (doubtful readings, letters chosen, supralinear words — the notes must say so)

# Establishment log — popol-vuh-021 (image 0066 from line 13, 0067, 0068, 0069 lines 1–19)

Read 2026-11-28 by the routine's own model from source/pages/i0066 (from the indented `Are cut vae qui nabal qui camic`,
line 13, after `… xban chique.`), all of i0067 and i0068, and i0069 to `… ta xebec cut ruꜭ ahau.` (its nineteenth line),
in strips of about seven lines at 1.15–1.2×, with 1.6–2× crops of doubtful words, checked word by word against Brasseur
1861 (OCR lines c. 26494–26700, his chapter 12 `CABLAHPAH CHI TZIH`, and c. 26800–27000, the opening of his chapter 13).
Pillow in a scratch venv.

Start: `Are cut vae qui nabal` (0066 l.13). End: `… camol que ta xebec cut ruꜭ ahau.` (0069 l.19), a paragraph end in the
MS; the next line is the indented paragraph `Xe opon puch cuꜭ ahauab, que mocho chic …`, which begins popol-vuh-022.
Brasseur's chapter 13 runs on about two more pages (the dog, the burnt house, the sacrificed man, the death of Hun Came
and Vucub Came) to `… xa pu qui halvachibal quib ta xqui bano.`; 022 should end there. The part was ended at the
Ximénez paragraph break inside the images the packet gave (0066–0069), rather than carried two pages past them.
parts.json: 022 images set to 0069–0072 (was 0072–0074, which would have left 0069–0071 unread); plan.md row updated.

Content: chapter 12 — the twins, forewarned, instruct the seers Xulu and Pacam what to answer when Xibalba asks how to
dispose of their bones (not the ravine, not hung on trees; ground like maize and thrown into the river); the great
oven; the twins refuse the game of flying over it, embrace, and go face down into the fire together; Xibalba rejoices;
the bones ground and thrown into the river; they sink and become handsome boys. Chapter 13 (beginning) — on the fifth
day they appear as fish-men (vinac car), then as two ragged poor men dancing the Puhuy, Cux, Yboy, Xꜩul and Chiꜩic,
burning houses and restoring them, sacrificing each other and coming back to life; the lords hear and send for them;
the twins protest that they are ashamed to go before the lords; they are driven along by the messengers.

Paragraphs: Ximénez's indents at `Are cut vae` (0066), `Chi robix cut` (0068) and `Cate chi puch roponic` (0068); the
others (`Ta xe pixabah`, `Are ca ban ri nima chohim abah`, `Que quicot`, `Catecut qui taquic`, `Xe opon cut cuꜭ ri
xahol`, `Xelehebex`) are ours at the sense joints, as 015–020.

## Folios
0066 carries `28` at the top left (28v), 0068 `29` (29v); so 0067 = 29r, 0069 = 30r → `fols. 28v–30r`.

## Nested speech
The twins' instructions to Xulu and Pacam quote what Xibalba will ask and what the seers are to answer
(`Vve que ꜭha chive: …, quix ꜭha.`), and the messenger's summons quotes the lord (`ca quix ca chohih, caꜭha ahau`,
`quecha ahauab, quix ꜭha chique`); printed inside one pair of “ ” with colons and the K'iche' speech verbs marking the
inner speech, as 017 (the pin check counts ‘ ’ as apostrophes).
